items.prompt: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמַיִם כִּי יהוה דִּבֵּר בָּנִים גִּדַּלְתִּי וְהֵם פָּשְׁעוּ בִי
items.answer: Hear, O heavens, for it is Yahweh that has spoken: Sons have I brought up, but, as for them, they have rebelled against me.

items.prompt: וְלָמָּה תְכַבְּדוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּבְּדוּ מִצְרַיִם וּפַרְעֹה אֶת־לִבָּם
items.answer: Why then will ye harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts?

items.prompt: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד אֱלֹהִים
items.answer: The heavens are telling the glory of God.

items.prompt: זִכְרוּ אֶת־יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ
items.answer: Remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy.

items.prompt: אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים הִתְהַלֶּךְ־נֹחַ
items.answer: Noah walked with God.

items.prompt: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־קוֹל יהוה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּגָּן לְרוּחַ הַיּוֹם וַיִּתְחַבֵּא הָאָדָם וְאִשְׁתּוֹ מִפְּנֵי יהוה
items.answer: And they heard the voice of Yahweh as he walked in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh.

items.prompt: וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ
items.answer: And no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that has been shed in it, except by the blood of him that shed it.

items.prompt: מַה־נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה־נִּצְטַדָּק
items.answer: What shall we speak, or how shall we justify ourselves?

items.prompt: הָאֶבְיוֹנִים מְבַקְשִׁים מַיִם וָאַיִן
items.answer: The poor are seeking water, and there is none.

items.prompt: את־פניך יהוה אבקש
items.answer: Thy face, Yahweh, I will seek.

items.prompt: נמצאו החמורים אשר הלכת לבקש
items.answer: The asses are found which thou wentest to seek.

items.prompt: ויקרא פרעה את־כל־חכמי מצרים ויספר להם את־חלמו
items.answer: And Pharaoh called all the wise men of Egypt, and he related to them his dream.

data.pointed: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶת־כָּל־חַכְמֵי מִצְרַיִם וַיְסַפֵּר לָהֶם אֶת־חֲלֹמוֹ

items.prompt: These are the words which I have spoken.
items.answer: אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי

items.prompt: Harden not your heart, lest Yahweh your God be angry.
items.answer: אַל־תְּכַבְּדוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם פֶּן־יִקְצֹף יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם

items.prompt: Seek ye his face.
items.answer: בַּקְּשׁוּ אֶת־פָּנָיו

items.prompt: Walk before me and sanctify yourselves.
items.answer: הִתְהַלְּכוּ לְפָנַי וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם

items.prompt: I cannot speak to this people, for they have hardened their heart.
items.answer: לֹא יָכֹלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי כִבְּדוּ אֶת־לְבָבָם

items.prompt: We heard the voice of Yahweh walking in the garden and we hid ourselves from his face.
items.answer: שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶת־קוֹל יְהוָה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּגָּן וַנִּתְחַבֵּא מִפָּנָיו

items.prompt: He said unto the woman, Speak, and the woman spoke.
items.answer: אָמַר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה דַּבֵּרִי וַתְּדַבֵּר הָאִשָּׁה

items.prompt: I will honour them that honour me.
items.answer: אֲכַבֵּד אֶת־מְכַבְּדַי

items.prompt: And now, behold, the king walketh (ptc.) before you, and I am old, and I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
items.answer: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי וַאֲנִי הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם מִנְּעֻרַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה
